Package gui

Class TabActiveReservationController

java.lang.Object
gui.TabActiveReservationController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Initializable
public class TabActiveReservationController extends Object implements Initializable
Controller class for the Active Reservations tab in the GUI. This class handles the display and management of active table reservations, allowing users to view current bookings and refresh the data from the server.

    • updateTableData

      public void updateTableData(ArrayList<data.TableReservation> serverData)
      Updates the TableView with a new list of reservations received from the server. This operation is thread-safe and executes on the JavaFX Application Thread.
      Parameters:
      serverData - The list of active TableReservation objects from the database.
